title: ahpC promoter compensation
dek: ahpC promoter-up is usually how Mtb lives with a broken katG, not a primary INH mechanism to treat as the cause. Report it as compensation.
story: KatG is both INH activator and catalase-peroxidase. Loss-of-function katG alleles (beyond tidy S315T) create oxidative stress. Promoter mutations that up-regulate ahpC (alkyl hydroperoxide reductase) compensate that stress. They are epidemiologically associated with INH-R isolates that already have katG lesions.

Calling INH-R from ahpC promoter alone, with katG WT and inhA WT, is a catalogue fight you should lose most days. Some pipelines still emit it as a resistance call. Grade katG/inhA first; mention ahpC as compensation or as a hint to re-inspect katG coverage.
This is the same intellectual object as rpoC compensation for rpoB: fitness recovery, not the drug-binding lesion. Different gene, same reporting hygiene.
deep: oxyR is inactivated in MTBC; the ahpC promoter sits in a small intergenic region that LPAs do not always cover.
S315T often does not need ahpC because residual catalase remains. Full katG deletions do.
Do not add high-dose INH because ahpC is WT. High-dose INH is an inhA-low-level bet.
ahpC coding mutations are a different, rarer conversation.

visual.caption: INH activation via KatG. When KatG is lost, ahpC promoter-up is the oxidative-stress patch, not a second INH target of equal dignity.
